headline: Week 1: QAmon Gets Curb-Stomped, Browning Benches a Buick
subhead: The season's first slate had a 61-point massacre, a Daniel Jones revival tour, and Patrick leaving 47 points on the pine like a goddamn lunatic.
matchOfTheWeek: Egbukkake hanging 152 on QAmon while Kyle's roster mustered a wet 91.20 was less a matchup and more a war crime. Szara traded for Drake Maye, Hunter Henry, Keenan Allen, AND Kyren Williams in the offseason and apparently QAmon traded for a participation ribbon. Perc Hurts dropped 24.28 while dead rat Spencer Rattler watched the ARbiter no-show — a 61-point beatdown to start a dynasty rebuild that is somehow already over.
mainRecap:
Welcome back, degenerates. Week 1 wasted no time reminding everyone who actually reads the waiver wire and who's just collecting Sleeper notifications.

Let's start with Patrick and Browning Out, who scored 131.96 and STILL lost by 27 because Justin Fields put up 29.52 on the bench. Forty-seven points left rotting on your pine, my guy. Zay Flowers went nuclear for 28.10 and you still found a way to lose to Nick — that's a special kind of malpractice. Meanwhile Nick rode Madison Beer's side piece (27.92), Mustard (24.40), and Nail polish enthusiast (24.20) to a 159-burger, then casually let Big Penix and Quentin Johnston combine for 48.92 on his bench because he can't pick a QB to save his life. Half his roster turned over in trades and he still won. Disgusting.

The Good Ladds dropped 167.68 because 3rd Overall Somehow remembered he's Josh Allen and went for 38.76. Mig also benched Keon Coleman for 25.20 — when you score 167 you don't get yelled at, but we see you. Stroud Boys got bukkake'd for 126 while Aaron Rodgers rotted on the bench for 25.66. The Prodigal Son did not return triumphantly. Bjewett, retire the Russell Wilson dart throw immediately.

McBridesStrangeWhiteHock hit 95% efficiency and dropped a league-high 168.60 on Tnicolle, who got 29.36 from Lamar and basically nothing else. Rocks made 47 trades and one of them was apparently "acquire 2025 Daniel Jones" — 29.48 points, and somehow that's a real sentence now.

Elsewhere, Christian McCalfinjury rode Derrick Henry's 29.20 to bury Little Peckers, where Unc and Mahomes' 26.02 weren't enough. OnlyFants squeaked past Rub My Chubb 126-109 in a game that felt like two guys arm-wrestling in a Waffle House parking lot. Cubby wins, BigD loses, nobody learned anything.

powerRankings.blurb: Made 19 trades, hit 95% lineup efficiency, and got 29 from Daniel Jones — Rocks is either a genius or just bullying the spreadsheet.
167 points, Josh Allen erupting, and Mig still has Keon Coleman dropping 25 on the bench like a hidden boss.
61-point blowout, Perc Hurts cooking, and a roster that looks like szara cheated in fantasy IRL.
Three QBs over 24 points and Nick still needed Mustard to bail him out — congrats on beating the league's most expensive bench.
Derrick Henry going for 29 is the only reason this team name isn't already prophetic.
126.80 is the fantasy equivalent of clearing your throat — a win is a win, Cubby, but nobody's scared.
Scored 131, lost by 27, and benched 47 points — Patrick literally Browned Out at the lineup screen.
Lamar dropped 29 and Tnicolle still got smoked by 38 — when your QB1 is a one-man show and the show closes opening night.
Traded for Nick Chubb AND Rico Dowdle and still couldn't crack 110 — BigD, the running back room is not the problem.
Mahomes goes for 26, Unc shows up, and you still lose by 36 — a perfectly on-brand debut for the trailing space in your team name.
Benched Aaron Rodgers for 25.66 and started Russell Wilson energy across the board — bjewett, the Prodigal Son cannot save this.
91.20 points, dead rat starting, ARbiter arbitrating nothing — Kyle, the rebuild is the season AND the punishment.

weeklyAwards.title: Curb Stomp Champion
weeklyAwards.blurb: Beat QAmon by 61.06 and somehow still has trade chips left to fleece the league again next week.

weeklyAwards.title: Daniel Jones Truther Trophy
weeklyAwards.blurb: Traded FOR Daniel Jones, started him, and got 29.48 — there's no god, only Rocks.

weeklyAwards.title: Loudest Quiet Loss
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lamar's 29.36 was a solo concert and the rest of the roster forgot the lyrics.
